issues.evidence: 4 ground-truth curves (prop_x=Temperature/K, prop_y=Electrical conductivity/ohm^(-1)*m^(-1)). x-values ~223-399K match the chart's printed x-axis range. 3 of 4 curves have y-values in 61130-103454 ohm^-1*m^-1, consistent with the chart's printed y-axis 'Electrical conductivity sigma, ohm^-1 cm^-1' spanning ~250-1250 after unit conversion (ohm^-1 cm^-1 * 100 = ohm^-1 m^-1). One of the 4 curves has an outlier range (662-1028 ohm^-1*m^-1, ~2 orders of magnitude below the other three) not yet independently reconciled against the chart -- flagged here for a future re-check rather than silently dropped.
